name: VectorizationAction
description: Vectorize SIMD-friendly operations by tiling to register-level sizes and applying MLIR vectorization. Due to limitations of MLIR's structured vectorization, this action is conservative and may not apply to many operations.

parameters.name: vector_size
parameters.description: SIMD vector width for the innermost vectorized dimension (e.g., 4 for AVX2 f64, 8 for AVX2 f32)
